scenarios.name: Add a decimal point inside an earlier number
scenarios.reason: The decimal-point click left the expression unchanged, so retrying is prohibited.
scenarios.diagnosis: After the cursor was placed between 2 and ×, the calculator ignored the decimal-point button instead of adding the point there.
scenarios.suggestion: Fix decimal-point entry so it inserts at the current cursor position when that position begins a valid decimal number, including immediately before an operator.
